slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Context engineering is repo discipline
slides.subtitle: Put durable project knowledge where the agent can find it.

slides.title: Every session needs context
slides.body: The agent needs project rules, commands, task tracker, workflows, roles, and pointers to important docs.

slides.title: Use a small root file
slides.body: AGENTS.md should be a map, not a full manual. For Claude Code, CLAUDE.md can simply point to AGENTS.md.

slides.title: Split focused docs
slides.body: Put process, testing, UI, API, deployment, PM, engineer, and QA guidance in separate files.

slides.title: Load only what matters
slides.body: For each task, the agent can read the relevant docs instead of carrying the whole project manual in every session.

slides.supportingText: A practical context setup for coding agents.
